_Description: Fallback protocol (see opts.protocol.fallback): T1w of all vendors and field strengths (3D MPRAGE, IR-FSPGR/BRAVO, TFE, MP2RAGE), broader than ADNI4 (field strengths 1-7 T, without TR, which is the TR of the inversion or of the readout), for scans that are nonconform to the protocols of the study but required for the evaluation (segmentation)
